title: Intermittent 503s
summary: A few times an hour, every page of the site answers 503 for ten seconds or so, then everything is fine again.
alert: [FLAPPING] Uptime monitor: the site answered 503, then recovered 12 s later (4 times in the last hour)

choices.label: The edge proxy, because no instance passes its readiness check
The API instances, from their error handler
Docker, while it restarts the instances

questions.prompt: Why do both instances fail their readiness check at the same time?

choices.label: Their readiness depends on TaxRate, which they share: when TaxRate is degraded, both fail it together
They restart at the same time

questions.prompt: What should an instance's readiness depend on?

choices.label: Only on what it needs to serve requests at all: a dependency's trouble should fail the requests that use it
TaxRate and PayFlow, since checkout needs them
Whatever the proxy's check has time for
